summary: Backend-only regression + deployment-blocker verification for wildlife portfolio. Updated existing pytest file to new admin password (Mihir@282878) and added new test module test_reorder_and_regression.py covering: reorder correctness (reverse + restore + order field validation), reorder empty ids, reorder auth (401), seed idempotency (exactly 16 photos, no duplicate public_ids, all have collection), core regression (/api/, /api/site with Reptiles collection, share-card fetchable Cloudinary URL), contact + print-request creation and admin-protected reads (401 without token, 200 with). All 25 tests pass (16 existing + 9 new). Test data cleaned up via direct Mongo (no DELETE endpoints exist for contact/print-requests).
critical_code_review_comments: No DELETE endpoints for /api/contact/{id} or /api/print-requests/{id}. Admin has no way to remove messages/print requests via API; cleanup is only possible via direct DB access. Consider adding admin-protected DELETE endpoints.
Reorder endpoint accepts ids that may not exist in DB; UpdateOne with no matched doc silently succeeds. Consider validating that all ids exist and returning 400 on mismatch to avoid partial reorders.
server.py is 519 lines — still within limit but starting to grow; consider splitting routes into modules if it crosses ~700 lines.
test_credentials: Admin password: Mihir@282878 (POST /api/admin/login returns token equal to password; use as Bearer)
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Test contact/print-request records were inserted and cleaned up via Mongo (contact_messages, print_requests collections). Reorder test reversed order and restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two test files under /app/backend/tests/: test_portfolio_api.py (photos, share-card, site, auth, update flow, series add/remove) and test_reorder_and_regression.py (reorder, seed idempotency, contact/print-request creation + admin list). Both use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Admin password is Mihir@282878. Note: /api/contact and /api/print-requests do NOT have DELETE endpoints — tests clean up via direct Mongo access using MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env.
rca of the issue: N/A — deployment-blocker fixes (bulk_write reorder + idempotent seed_data with photos_seeded flag) verified working. 16 photos, unique public_ids, correct order after reorder, empty ids handled, auth enforced.
